title: 反而 (actually (opposite to what one expects))
longExplanation: actually (opposite to what one expects). Pinyin: fǎn'ér

examples.sentence: 大城市的生活虽然很精彩，但一辈子生活在农村的父母反而会不适应。
examples.romanization: dàchéngshì de shēnghuó suīrán hěn jīngcǎi， dàn yībèizi shēnghuó zài nóngcūn de fùmǔ fǎn'ér huìbùhuì shìyìng。
examples.translation: Although the life in a big city is very exciting, [my] parents who have lived in rural areas for a lifetime will actually (opposite to what one expects) find themselves ill-adapted.

examples.sentence: 比赛前做好思想准备可以减少运动员的压力，从而取得比赛的成功。
examples.romanization: bǐsài qián zuò hǎo sīxiǎng zhǔnbèi kěyǐ jiǎnshǎo yùndòngyuán de yālì， cóng'ér qǔdé bǐsài de chénggōng。
examples.translation: Preparing mentally before the game can reduce the stress on the athletes [and] consequently achieve the success of the game.

title: V 于 N (V in N)
longExplanation: V in N. Pinyin: V yú N

examples.romanization: zhè jiā gōngsī chénglì yú1997 nián。

title: V 于 N (V to N)
longExplanation: V to N. Pinyin: V yú N

examples.sentence: 李明没办法，只好求助于当经理的老同学王峰。
examples.romanization: lǐ míng méibànfǎ， zhǐhǎo qiúzhù yú dāng jīnglǐ de lǎo tóngxué wáng fēng。
examples.translation: Li Ming had no choice but to turn to Wang Feng (for help), the old classmate of the manager.

title: V 于 N (V from N)
longExplanation: V from N. Pinyin: V yú N

examples.sentence: 他出身于知识分子家庭。
examples.translation: He came from an intellectual family.

title: A 于 N (A to N)
longExplanation: A to N. Pinyin: A yú N

title: A 于 N (A from/than N)
longExplanation: A from/than N. Pinyin: A yú N

examples.sentence: 水生动物不同于陆地动物。
examples.romanization: shuǐshēng dòngwù bùtóng yú lùdì dòngwù。
examples.translation: Aquatic creatures are different from terrestrial ones.

title: V 为 (wéi) N (V into N)
longExplanation: V into N. Pinyin: V wéi (wéi) N

examples.translation: Stress can also be turned into strength.

title: V 为 (wéi) N (V as N)
longExplanation: V as N. Pinyin: V wéi (wéi) N

examples.sentence: 在他看来，没有工作的生活就不能称其为生活。
examples.romanization: zài tā kànlai， méiyǒu gōngzuò de shēnghuó jiù bùnéng chēng qí wéi shēnghuó。
examples.translation: In his view, life without work cannot be called (as) life.

examples.sentence: 地下水积蓄起来，越积越多。
examples.romanization: dìxiàshuǐ jīxù qilai， yuè jī yuè duō。
examples.translation: The groundwater is store (up) and accumulates.

title: 藏起来/躲起来 (V away)
longExplanation: V away. Pinyin: cáng qilai/ duǒ qilai

examples.sentence: 刘丽知道自己做得不对，躲起来不敢见我。
examples.romanization: Liú lì zhīdào zìjǐ zuò dé bùduì， duǒ qilai bù gǎn jiàn wǒ。
examples.translation: Liu Li knows that she is doing something wrong, and she hides [herself] away and does not dare to see me.

examples.sentence: 见了外公，请替我向他问好。
examples.romanization: jiàn le wàigōng， qǐng tì wǒ xiàng tā wènhǎo。
examples.translation: When you see my grandfather, please say hello to him (on my behalf).

examples.sentence: 李阳要去留学了，我们都替他高兴。
examples.romanization: lǐ yáng yào qù liúxué le， wǒmen dōu tì tā gāoxìng。
examples.translation: Li Yang is going to study abroad, and we are all happy for him.

examples.sentence: 这事儿经理已经同意了，只是出发的时间还说不定。
examples.romanization: zhè shìr jīnglǐ yǐjīng tóngyì le， zhǐshì chūfā de shíjiān hái shuōbudìng。
examples.translation: The manager has already agreed, but the time of departure is still uncertain.
